text: 45 Do you know? • Have you ever tasted cheese? • Do you like cheese? Neel was a student of Grade One. He disliked reading. One day, Neel asked his mother for a cheese roll. She said, ‘‘If you tell me what cheese is made of, I will make one for you.’’ At once, Neel ran to the bookshelf. After searching for some time, he found a book named ‘All ABOUT CHEESE’. He started reading the book and found it interesting. He read all about how cheese is made. He enjoyed reading the book. He went to his mother and said, ‘‘Aai, cheese is made from milk!’’ He told the process to her. Mother gave him the cheese roll. Now, Neel loves to read books. They are his best friends. Books are my best friends. 3.4 1. Listen, read and discuss. 2. Answer the following questions. 3. Read a story of your choice and talk about it. (1) What did Neel want? (2) How is the cheese made? (3) Neel read a book about how cheese is made. Which book would you like to read?
